description.value:
Ability Scores: Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.feats.Item.phbftMagicInitia]{Magic Initiate} (Cleric)

Skill Proficiencies: Insight and Religion

Tool Proficiency: Calligrapher’s Supplies

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulCalligraph]{Calligrapher’s Supplies}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagBook0000000]{Book} (prayers), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagHolySymbolV]{Holy Symbol}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagParchment00]{Parchment} (10 sheets), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagRobe0000000]{Robe}, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

You devoted yourself to service in a temple, either nestled in a town or secluded in a sacred grove. There you performed rites in honor of a god or pantheon. You served under a priest and studied religion. Thanks to your priest’s instruction and your own devotion, you also learned how to channel a modicum of divine power in service to your place of worship and the people who prayed there.

advancement.title: Background Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Background Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you proficiency in Insight and Religion. It also grants you proficiency in Calligrapher's Supplies.

advancement.title: Background Feat
advancement.hint: Your background grants you the Magic Initiate (Cleric) feat.

advancement.title: Choose Languages
advancement.hint: Your character knows at least three languages: Common plus two languages you roll or choose from the Standard Languages table.
